name: Calendly
tagline: Calendly is the most widely used scheduling automation tool, letting recipients book meetings directly into your calendar based on your real availability. It eliminates the back-and-forth of finding a time by sharing a booking link, and AI-powered features now suggest meeting slots and draft follow-up emails. Integrated with Zoom, Google Meet, Salesforce, and dozens of other tools.
